newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Some Australia cross media links justified-Alston.
newsitem.headline: Some Australia cross media links justified-Alston.

text.p: Australian Communications minister Richard Alston said on Thursday the Australian government could not ignore legitimate commercial reasons for cross media ownership.
"Governments cannot ignore the fact that digital compression and technological convergence are realities for the here and now," Alston told a conference on media ownership.

Alston said many media companies saw the need to have interests across the communications sector not only to achieve economies of scale but also to bring commercial and technical expertise to new markets.
"These are legitimate competitive efficiency aspirations which should only be curtailed for demonstrable public interest considerations," Alston said.
